note: Medicare rebate amounts are approximate and may change. Check Services Australia for current rates.
reviewNotes: Rebates verified on MBS Online 2026-09-03, all 'Schedule Fee Updated 01-Jul-2026' (85% benefit): general psychologist item 80110 $101.55; clinical psychologist item 80010 $149.05; mental health social worker item 80135 $89.50; mental health occupational therapist item 80160 $89.50; psychiatrist first appointment item 296 (45+ min, new or returning patient) $268.90; psychiatrist follow-up item 302 (15-30 min) $89.30.

Psychiatrist follow-up lengths (followUpLengths), MBS Online at 1 Jul 2026 rates: item 302 (15-30 min) $89.30, item 304 (30-45 min) $137.45, item 306 (45-75 min) $189.70. 302 is the default and matches the psychiatrist 'rebate' field and 'chips'.

Psychiatrist follow-up fee chips per length: Medical Costs Finder (medicalcostsfinder.health.gov.au), national out-of-hospital psychiatry claims 2023-24, fee = Medicare paid + patient out-of-pocket (low/typical/high). 302: $145/$215/$275; 304: $200/$290/$360; 306: $244/$370/$475. Scaled x1.09 to 2026 (the rise in the rebate since 2023-24) and rounded. Research notes: docs/plans/psychiatrist-follow-up-fees.md. Re-check after the 2025-26 data is published.
REVIEW: psychiatrist receipt note says rebates roughly halve after 50 psychiatrist sessions in a calendar year — needs checking against the MBS items for attendances after the 50th.

Earlier versions labelled the psychiatrist initial rebate as item 291. That item is the one-off assessment-and-management-plan attendance ($467.45 from 1 Jul 2026), not a normal first appointment. Item 296 is the right one.
Counsellors and psychotherapists have no Medicare rebate (not in the Better Access scheme); rebate 0 and setup null so the GP question and 'one-off to get started' block are hidden.

chips = the quick-pick fee buttons (Lower / Typical / Higher). General psychologist 200/250/330 is sourced: Help Link 2026 network data across 371 psychologists (median $245, average $237, range $0-$360) and the APS recommended 2026-27 rate $330, verified 2026-09-03. REVIEW: every other chip range (except psychiatrist follow-ups, sourced above) is a placeholder taken from the practitioners page ranges and needs a source.
Next indexation expected 1 Jul 2027 — re-check figures after that date.
